record_type_quote: Despite excellent statistical power (≥98.7%), and close procedural replications of two out of three previous studies (Cobey et al., 2013;Roberts, Little, et al., 2014), we did not find support for the HC congruency hypothesis.

targets.authors: Cobey, K. D., Roberts, S. C., & Buunk, A. P.
targets.title: Hormonal contraceptive congruency: Implications for relationship jealousy.
targets.evidence_quote: Despite using exactly the same measures as used in all previous studies except one (Russell et al., 2014) as well as additional, well-validated alternative measures, we were unable to confirm the results concerning sexual satisfaction reported by Roberts, Little, et al. (2014) and Russell et al. (2014), or the results concerning jealousy reported by Cobey et al. (2013).
